hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"pip install"*|*"pip3 install"*|*"poetry add"*|*"poetry install"*|*"poetry run"*) echo 'BLOCK: this repo is uv-only (I-15). Use: uv add <package>. Note uv pip install bypasses uv.lock and is also disallowed.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1 | head -20;; esac; exit 0
